svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print six plates 150 mm across and 4 mm thick in white ASA.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All six: three 5.2 mm holes on a 110 mm circle, 120 degrees apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top plate (one): solid, with a 7 mm hole in the centre for the sensor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lead and two M5 heat-set inserts 30 mm each side of the centre, in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ring plates (five): a 70 mm hole in the middle so air can pass.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stack on three M5 stainless rods with 24 mm nylon spacers between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the plates (28 mm pitch); nuts above the top and below the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The sensor hangs on its lead inside the stack, 25 mm below the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M5 screws through the arm's flat leg into the inserts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plates are parallel and the sensor does not touch them.
